# ScottSearch 0.1.4 — workspace-friendly startup indexing

This human-testing patch addresses a beta report that Obsidian could appear to
hang on **Loading workspace** while ScottSearch was enabled. ScottSearch 0.1.3
started a full-vault rebuild directly from the workspace-ready callback and
read notes 20 at a time, which could compete with restoration in a large vault.

## Fixed

- Workspace readiness now schedules automatic indexing after a five-second
  grace period instead of starting full-vault reads inside the callback.
- Opening or using ScottSearch starts indexing immediately, so the grace period
  does not delay an explicit search workflow.
- Lexical indexing reads at most four notes concurrently and yields between
  batches to reduce sustained main-event-loop pressure.
- Disabling or unloading the plugin cancels deferred startup work.
- An explicit rebuild cancels the deferred copy, preventing two initial
  rebuilds from racing.
- Incremental create, edit, rename, and delete handling is unchanged.

Automated lifecycle tests cover deferral, explicit start, unload cancellation,
batch concurrency, yielding, and superseded rebuilds. Real Obsidian startup
timing remains part of the public human beta; this release does not claim a
device or private-vault result that was not measured.

## Privacy and compatibility

The patch changes only when and how local indexing work is scheduled. It adds
no network request, telemetry, or note mutation. Optional Ollama behavior is
unchanged, and unreleased on-device experiments remain excluded from the public
bundle.

ScottSearch supports Obsidian 1.7.2 or later on macOS, Windows, Linux, iPhone,
iPad, and Android. This remains a pre-release for human testing rather than a
stable Community-directory submission.

## Install or update

BRAT users can update ScottSearch normally. For a manual installation,
download `scottsearch-0.1.4.zip` below, unzip it, place the enclosed
`scottsearch` folder inside `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/`, restart Obsidian, and
enable ScottSearch under **Settings → Community plugins**.

Please retry startup and submit sanitized results through the
[friendly beta form](https://github.com/c4g-john/scottsearch-for-obsidian/issues/new?template=beta_test_report.yml).
Do not include private note text, paths, or credentials in public reports.

To roll back, reinstall 0.1.3 from its release page. Neither update nor rollback
deletes notes.
